text:
Samir: Taking handoff from Devon for night shift. Primary = Samir, Secondary = Olivia. I'm on-call from 21:00 UTC -> 05:00 UTC. Key note: known partial degradation on /v1/generate (investigated earlier) — appear stable but watch for error spikes. Handing off context below.

roster-bot: Oncall roster updated: Primary: Samir, Secondary: Olivia. Pager schedule: https://roster.redwood/internal/schedule (confirm local timezone).

Devon: Leaving context — active incident INC-472: generator timeouts in us-west2, mitigated by fallback to compact-model. Root cause suspected network flaps to endpoint pool. Customer impact: intermittent 500s for a small percentage of requests, started ~20:12 UTC. Actions taken: rolled canary, added retry 2x for short-window, escalated to networking team.

Samir: Got it. Will watch metrics and logs. @Maya, if PD pages `sev2` or above, can you own customer comms?

Maya: Yep. I have the current status page snippet ready. If we hit >1% error rate or any SLO breach, I'll post an update. :white_check_mark:

Olivia: Paging rules reminder: 1) Sev1 — page primary + eng lead + incident commander. 2) Sev2 — page primary + secondary + networking. 3) Sev3 — notify primary only. Thresholds: 5xx >1% sustained over 5m => Sev2. Any site-wide 5xx spike or data loss => Sev1.

Samir: Adding runbook pointers: runbook -> https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/generator-timeouts. Quick ops commands: `kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=generator -o wide` and `curl -sS https://metrics.internal/api?query=rate(5xx[5m]) | tail`.

incident-bot: INC-472 updated: state=monitoring, severity=2, assignees=[Devon,Samir], bridge=https://call.redwood/INC-472.

Leo: FYI product: one enterprise customer (AcmeCorp) saw retries from webhook consumers. If escalation is needed, they require a dedicated incident call and postmortem.

Samir: Understood. If we escalate to Sev1, I'll loop in product + CS + Eng lead. For now I'll keep active watch and tighten alert sensitivities.

Devon: Two tactical notes: 1) If host-level 502/504 persists, we can toggle fallback to `model-compact` via `./ops/switch-backend --pool us-west2 --model compact` (safe short-term). 2) We have a KV-cache scrub script `scripts/clear-kv.sh` — run only if tail latency > 300ms and after consult.

Samir: I'm going to run a quick smoke after the redeploy. Will post any results here. Paging policy reminder: always append attempted mitigations and runbook link in PD notes.

Maya: Preparing canned customer message: "We're investigating elevated errors affecting generation. No ETA yet; will update in 30 minutes or sooner." Will hold until severity changes.

Olivia: Operational note: if PagerDuty pages and primary is unreachable for 5 minutes, escalate to #oncall-ops and call the secondary directly. Also please ping `incident-bot ack` once you accept.

Samir: Thanks team — starting 2h watch. Will update on any metric deviation >0.5% 5xx or any manual pager. Leaving log marker here for cross-shift continuity.
